test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 23 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The train is running / late by six hours / so it / cannot make over the time.
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. cannot make over the time .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"make over the time"** is incorrect because the proper expression is **"make up the time"**, which means to compensate for lost time.
 
• The sentence describes a delay in the train’s schedule, and it is not possible to recover the time lost due to the delay.
 
• Thus, the error lies in segment 2: **"cannot make over the time".**

Correct sentence: *The train is running late by six hours, so it **cannot make up the time**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Common phrases with "make":**

 
 
• **Make up for:** To compensate for something.
 
**Example:** He worked hard to make up for the lost time.
 
• **Make up:** To reconcile or resolve a conflict.
 
**Example:** They finally made up after their argument.
 
 
 
• **Usage of "make up the time":**
 
 
• It is commonly used in contexts like travel or schedules to indicate recovering lost time.
